items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: well we had Coco and all them guys used to come out there...Coco the guitar player

ctx.x: Charlie LeConte used to come...yeah...I don't know what happened to him...

I don't either...well we had Coco and all them guys used to come out there...Coco the guitar player...we had Bill the bass player...we had Stanley Maddelson...used to come out there...the piano player...
